title: Single window of an application with multiple windows open cannot be dragged into Activity Switcher
line: A single window can now be dragged out of a grouped task's tooltip and dropped on an activity in the Activities sidebar.
explanation: The window thumbnails (and, with thumbnails off, the window rows) in a grouped task's tooltip only had hover and tap handlers, so pressing and dragging one started no drag at all. Only the whole task button could be dragged, which carries every window of the group. The change adds a drag handler to each tooltip window entry that starts a drag through the task manager's existing drag helper, carrying only that window's id with a half-size grab of the thumbnail as drag image.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: allow dragging windows out of the tooltip

Window thumbnails in a grouped task's tooltip had no drag source, so one
window of the group couldn't be dropped on an activity in the sidebar.
Add a drag handler that carries that window's drag data, like a task.

BUG: 442499

media.caption: Master: pressing the Music thumbnail in the Dolphin group tooltip and dragging it towards Test2 starts no drag; no drop zones appear and the window stays.
Fixed: the Music thumbnail is dragged onto Test2, the Move to / Show also drop zones appear, and after the drop only the Music window leaves the current activity; Home stays.
Master: recording of the failed thumbnail drag.

review.text: Adding a DragHandler to ToolTipInstance.qml is the right approach and file to enable dragging a single window out of a grouped task's tooltip, and the before/after media demonstrates the single-window drag working when paired with the Wayland drop fix (484722). However, the DragHandler implementation has several QML/DnD hazards around shared dragHelper lifecycle, async grabToImage safety on pooled/destroyed delegates, and text-only tooltip preview sizing.
changes: Remove dragHelper.Drag.active = false (and unconditional imageSource clearing) from DragHandler.onActiveChanged's else branch: with Drag.Automatic, the tooltip hiding or losing pointer focus during a drag deactivates DragHandler and can prematurely cancel the drag or clobber a shared dragHelper; let Drag.Automatic finish (or clean up after startDrag/onDragFinished) and explicitly set dragHelper.Drag.hotSpot so it doesn't inherit a stale hotspot from Task.qml.

Guard the async parent.grabToImage callback against dragHandler being destroyed or the delegate being pooled (root.index === -1), and verify that MimeType and MimeData are valid before starting the drag.
Avoid halving parent's size in grabToImage for the compact text-only headerItem (when showToolTips is false), reserving the 1/2 scale for thumbnailSourceItem.
Ensure the prerequisite Wayland Activity Switcher drop fix (484722) lands before or alongside this commit so closing BUG: 442499 actually completes the drop on Wayland.
